LanguageData.LP_MusicInspired.label: inspired
LanguageData.LP_MusicInspired.description: The musician's playing still echoes in the heart: surgery success, negotiation ability and shooting accuracy ×1.3.
LanguageData.LP_FeatDisguised.label: disguise
LanguageData.LP_FeatDisguised.description: Changed appearance and blended into the crowd: enemies almost never prioritize targeting.
LanguageData.LP_FeatPoisonedBlade.label: poisoned weapon
LanguageData.LP_FeatPoisonedBlade.description: The weapon is coated in poison: melee hits apply spider queen venom (value = remaining uses).
LanguageData.LP_RitualPrimed.label: ritual afterglow
LanguageData.LP_RitualPrimed.description: The power of the ritual lingers: the next cast triggers no cooldown and adds no neural heat.
LanguageData.LP_BorrowedLuck.label: borrowed luck
LanguageData.LP_BorrowedLuck.description: Luck shared by a halfling: the next wound that would down or kill takes only 10%.
LanguageData.LP_SnackComfort.label: snack aftertaste
LanguageData.LP_SnackComfort.description: Ate a good snack: wound healing +25%.
